نبتني (form VIII)
# نَبْتَنِي (nabtanī) /nab.ta.niː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
# نَبْتَنِيَ (nabtaniya) /nab.ta.ni.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
